topics.definition: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence.
tips: AI learns from data and rules.

topics.definition: AI began as a research field in the 1950s and has advanced rapidly with better algorithms and computing power.
tips: Modern AI is driven by data and GPUs.

topics.definition: AI is commonly classified as Narrow AI, General AI and Super AI.
tips: Today's AI is mostly Narrow AI.

topics.topic: AI vs Machine Learning vs Deep Learning
topics.definition: AI is the broad field, Machine Learning is a subset of AI, and Deep Learning is a subset of Machine Learning.
topics.example: Image recognition using deep neural networks

topics.definition: AI is used in healthcare, finance, education, robotics, transportation and entertainment.
tips: AI is used in many industries.

topics.definition: AI improves efficiency, accuracy, automation and decision-making.
AI depends on data quality, requires computing resources and lacks true human understanding.
Develop AI systems responsibly with high-quality data, testing and ethical considerations.
